rationale: Currently, success/error messages are shown inline within components (e.g., error divs in forms). Users lose feedback context when navigating or scrolling. A toast system provides non-intrusive, consistent feedback that persists briefly and doesn't disrupt workflow.
problemSolved: Error and success messages are displayed inline within form components using div elements with role='alert'. When actions succeed (like product creation), there is no positive feedback - users only see the modal close. Error messages disappear when components unmount or users navigate away.
